column4: 上午 means "morning"; plain "mañana" collides with 明天 (w067, "tomorrow" = mañana). Using the noun with the article marks it as "the morning", not the adverb "tomorrow"
字 means a single written Chinese character, not "word" (that's 词); including "palabra" blurs a distinction this app should be teaching
